description.value:
Arcs of lightning wreathe your body, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet; you can end the power early with your action.

For the duration, any creature within 5 feet of you that hits you with a melee attack takes 2d8 lightning damage.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 4
